lines.text: Job asks God to withdraw His hand and not frighten him, then to call him so he can answer.
Job asks why God considers him a servant and whether God would chase after dry chaff.
Job says man is short of days and full of trouble, and like a flower he withers away.
Job says a tree that is cut down will sprout again at the scent of fire.
Job says a man does not know if his sons are honored or brought low.
